description: The bar chart, titled “Targets,” illustrates the annual number of datasets categorized by whether they are “Untargeted” (blue) or “Targeted” (orange) from 2012 to 2022, as part of the systematic review “The Unseen Targets of Hate.” The horizontal axis represents the year, ranging from 2012 to 2022, while the vertical axis indicates the “Number of datasets,” scaled from 0 to 160 in increments of 20. Each year is represented by a stacked bar, with the lower blue segment denoting “Untargeted” datasets and the upper orange segment representing “Targeted” datasets. The chart reveals a clear upward trend in total datasets over time, with minimal activity before 2016. In 2012–2015, only 1–2 datasets per year were recorded, mostly untargeted. From 2016 onward, both categories grow, with targeted datasets consistently outnumbering untargeted ones after 2017. Notably, 2021 shows the highest total at 160 datasets (approximately 65 untargeted and 95 targeted), while 2022 shows a decline to around 40 total datasets (roughly 10 untargeted and 30 targeted). The legend in the top-left corner clarifies the color coding, and the bars are arranged chronologically without sorting by magnitude. No annotations or emphasis are applied to specific bars beyond the color-coded stacking.
